svg.title: Trade District / High Street study
svg.desc: Painterly street-level study down the High Street toward the square and the Town Hall clock tower, late-autumn morning, warm low sun from upper left; a dark back alley opens on the right.
svg.text: GD / TRADE DISTRICT / HIGH STREET STUDY
Late-autumn morning / warm low sun from upper left / looking east down the High Street to the square and the Town Hall clock.
Shifting eaves, 40 cm jetties, turned corner gables and striped awnings lead the eye down the High Street to the Town Hall clock.
Right: the mouth of a back alley, a deliberate drop in light and care: smoked timber, stained and patched plaster, standing water, refuse, laundry.
Mood study from first-floor eye height (5 m); perspective composition, not a measured V3 capture. Rows 9-16 m / storeys 320 cm / bays 200 cm / roofs 50° / clock tower 36 m.
CONCEPT / NOVEMBER 2026 • PROPOSED, NOT AN ENGINE CAPTURE • SIGNS AND BANNERS ARE BLANK OR NEUTRAL BY RULE
